metadata.topic: AI Futures Scenarios & Expert Discourse - UPDATED

summary: AGI timeline consensus shifted dramatically. Lab leaders now predict 2026-2027, not 2047. We are at ASL-3 since May 2025. o3 achieved 87.5% on ARC-AGI (human avg: 85%). The question is no longer 'when' but 'how fast is the transition'.

dario_amodei.key_quote: Country of geniuses in a datacenter

sam_altman.source: Y Combinator interview, The Intelligence Age blog

arc_agi.significance: o3 EXCEEDS human average on novel reasoning

autonomy_duration.example: Claude Code - $1B revenue run rate by Nov 2025

we_are_here.governance: Fragmented - EU AI Act enforcing, US EO revoked

fast_takeoff_2027.probability: No longer fringe - supported by lab leaders
fast_takeoff_2027.key_risk: ASL-4 capabilities before ASL-4 safeguards defined

slow_takeoff.mechanism: Bottlenecks in data, algorithms, or deployment slow progress
slow_takeoff.probability: Lower than previously thought given 2024-2025 pace

plateau.description: Current paradigm hits walls, need new breakthroughs
plateau.mechanism: Scaling laws stop working, diminishing returns
plateau.probability: Low - no evidence of plateau in 2024-2025

key_events: Claude Code hits $1B revenue run rate
2025.governance: EU GPAI provisions effective Aug 2025, US EO revoked Jan 2025

scenario_fork.fast: Autonomous AI R&D, recursive improvement begins

2027.governance_critical: Do we have ASL-4 safeguards ready?

2030.range: From aligned ASI solving problems to unaligned catastrophe

not_if_but_how_fast.question: How quickly do capabilities scale from here?
not_if_but_how_fast.optimist: Gradual enough for governance to keep up

alignment_at_scale.question: Do current techniques (RLHF, Constitutional AI) scale to ASI?
alignment_at_scale.pessimist: Deceptive alignment undetectable until too late

open_vs_closed_endgame.question: DeepSeek proved open-source can match frontier. What happens when open = ASL-4?
open_vs_closed_endgame.implication: Cannot contain capabilities through closed models

governance_gap.question: EU regulating, US deregulating, China racing. Who steers?
governance_gap.risk: No one has authority when it matters most
